## Summary

Describe the exact change and its reason.

## Scope

- Semester:
- Subject / paper code:
- Day / topic:
- Change type: new content / correction / question bank / syllabus / workflow / other
- Stable IDs added or changed:

## Sources and legal verification

- [ ] Applicable official syllabus checked for the relevant programme/batch.
- [ ] Statutory provisions checked against the official enacted text.
- [ ] Amendments and commencement details checked where relevant.
- [ ] Case name, court, citation and holding verified, or case clearly labelled as an unverified lead.
- [ ] Sources are linked and their role is clear.

## Exam-question authenticity

Choose the applicable status:
- [ ] Verified PYQ — actual paper inspected; year/session, subject code and source recorded.
- [ ] Predicted question — syllabus-based suggestion, not represented as a past question.
- [ ] Original practice question.
- [ ] No question-bank content changed.

## Preservation and quality

- [ ] Existing material inspected before editing.
- [ ] No unrelated content removed or overwritten.
- [ ] Existing question entries retained; duplicates cross-linked or labelled.
- [ ] New/changed files linked from the right index/dashboard.
- [ ] Subject changelog updated where applicable.
- [ ] Root changelog updated.
- [ ] Automated internal-link check passes.
- [ ] Final diff reviewed and remaining limitations documented.

## Owner decision

- [ ] Ready for owner review; not yet authorised to merge.
- [ ] Owner explicitly authorised this exact PR for merge.

Checks do not guarantee perfection. Do not merge until the repository owner reviews the final version and clearly authorises it.
